newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: ANZ launches facility for MAS plane sale.
newsitem.headline: ANZ launches facility for MAS plane sale.

text.p: ANZ said on Wednesday it had launched syndication on behalf of Jet Airways of India of a US$50.4 million facility to part finance purchase of two Boeing 737-400 aircraft from Malaysian Airline System.
ANZ Investment Bank said in a statement the hire purchase facility represented the first major acquisition of aircraft by a private Indian operator.

Later this year Boeing will deliver the first of 10 new 737 aircraft to Jet, which will eventually take its fleet size to 22 and an anticipated 30 percent share of the domestic market, the statement said.

The facility carries a coupon of 1.5 percent over LIBOR with monthly instalments representing interest and principal culminating in a final balloon payment to effect ownership transfer after 35 months. -- Singapore newsroom 65-8703080
